name: OptinMonster
couldBuild: Popups, slide-ins and an exit-intent trigger. Genuinely a weekend.
stillMissing: Campaigns, A/B splits, targeting rules and the analytics behind them all run on their infrastructure. The plugin is a loader.
requirements: Popup, slide-in, floating bar and inline campaign types with a visual editor
Display rules: exit intent, scroll depth, time on page, referrer, device
A/B split testing with per-variant impression and conversion counters
Email-provider integrations via a pluggable adapter (start with one)
A results dashboard with conversion rate per campaign
